asset_set: Silverwing Furnace Freightworks original warm rescue stage
generator: Built-in image_gen; five independent original generations; approved Silverwing concept visually inspected for art direction only

layers.strategy: Opaque overscan plate. At camera=14000 right extent is 1430, 150 pixels beyond 1280 viewport. No far seam enters the camera range. Never modulo or stretch to viewport.
layers.packing: Near-uniform resize 1983x793 to 1920x768 (<0.03% aspect rounding), then crop y=24..744. Lossless RGBA WebP.

layers.strategy: Open architecture and ledge in one genuinely transparent cutout. 1280px source arrangement plus horizontal reflection, giving exact RGBA edge and middle joins. Draw complete 2560px repeats.
layers.packing: Near-uniform resize 1672x941 to 1280x720 (<0.06% aspect rounding), then reflection. Source alpha preserved, including structural holes.

layers.strategy: Lower-edge standalone pipe strip drawn after actors and before HUD. Earliest possible alpha is y=622, safely 48px below floor. Visible alpha>8 starts at y=631. No tall pieces can cover combat.
layers.packing: Crop original 2172x724 to y=452..652, preserving all alpha>8 silhouette and discarding only faint padding dust. Resize 1280x118 (<0.2% aspect rounding), then reflection. Retained alpha unchanged.

props.strategy: Warm walkable floor strip. Top contact edge begins at texture y=0. Prefer FLOOR draw y for grounded alignment; collision remains independent. Exact RGBA joins at x=0/870 and x=435.
props.packing: Original source crop x=600..1470, y=255..495 resized uniformly 0.5 to 435x120 and reflected to 870x120. No perspective warp.

props.strategy: Original empty restraint cradle with two red/gold pylons, three slender warm energy bands and amber lock terminal. Transparent middle allows a separately drawn pilot; no character is baked in.
props.packing: Uniform resize original 1254x1254 to 256x256. Source alpha and partial luminous alpha preserved.

import_recommendation.compression: Lossless WebP. Exact RGBA decode verified against deterministic packed pixels. No palette quantization, alpha key, or lossy color compression.
import_recommendation.repeat: Disable texture_repeat if drawing complete repeat copies manually.

limitations: Middle, foreground, and floor use honest mirrored periodicity; repeated symmetric motifs remain visible if scrutinized.
Foreground vertical crop removes only faint alpha<=8 generator dust outside the useful silhouette. Floor deliberately selects a central 870x240 artwork slice, then resamples and mirrors it.
Source cutouts contain partial alpha inside some surfaces and luminous bands; retained as generated.
All five runtime textures total 3663198 bytes (3.49 MiB), exceeding the 2.5 MB aim in order to retain exact lossless art and true alpha.
Far coverage assumes viewport width=1280 and camera_x<=14000.
Foreground safety assumes its y origin stays at 622 or lower; do not offset it upward with jump camera motion.
